struct InputReader {
    std::istream& stream;
    std::vector<char> buf;
    int curChar;
    int numChars;
    InputReader(std::istream& s): stream(s), buf(1024), curChar(0), numChars(0) {}
    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1) throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatch");
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            stream.read(buf.data(), buf.size());
            numChars = (int)stream.gcount();
            curChar = 0;
            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }
    int peek() {
        if (numChars == -1) return -1;
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            stream.read(buf.data(), buf.size());
            numChars = (int)stream.gcount();
            curChar = 0;
            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar];
    }
    int readInt() {
        int c = read(); while (isspace(c)) c = read();
        int sgn = 1; if (c == '-') { sgn = -1; c = read(); }
        int res = 0; do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatch");
            res *= 10; res += c - '0'; c = read();
        } while (!isspace(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }
    long long readLong() {
        int c = read(); while (isspace(c)) c = read();
        int sgn = 1; if (c == '-') { sgn = -1; c = read(); }
        long long res = 0; do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatch");
            res *= 10; res += c - '0'; c = read();
        } while (!isspace(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }
    std::string readString() {
        int c = read(); while (isspace(c)) c = read();
        std::ostringstream res; do {
            if (c >= 0) res << (char)c; c = read();
        } while (!isspace(c));
        return res.str();
    }
    char readCharacter() {
        int c = read();
        while (isspace(c)) c = read();
        return (char)c;
    }
};
